vintage: Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1365 as amended (consolidated text poz. 1395, last change poz. 1412)

flood_2024.rule: Every gmina named by the Council of Ministers' regulation on the state of natural disaster of 16 September 2024 and its amendments. A named powiat covers all its gminas. Malomice is partial because the act named only the town. The area is an administrative declaration, not a measure of flood depth or damage.
